_doc: The tray (tray.py): which typed commands it handles itself before the model, its menu and on-screen wording, timings, limits, the chat flyout's sizes, fonts and colours. Edit tray.json, not this file: this one holds the shipped defaults, and any value in tray.json that is missing or invalid is logged and replaced by its default here (json_config.py). DENISSE_TRAY_CONFIG points at another file (tests). Sizes are logical pixels (scaled by the screen's DPI). Times say their unit in the key name. Read once at start-up. The orb's accent colours come from ui_theme.json's palette (accent, accent_bright), shared with the orb.

commands._doc: Typed in the chat. route.<name> is 'tray' (the tray acts on a whole-message match itself, before and without the model: works with Ollama down, costs no model call, but the turn is not in her history) or 'model' (the message goes to the model like any other, which acts through its own tools -- study: the study_* tools; reminders: list_tasks, in chat rather than the card). With 'model', a match while the model isn't connected (or offline mode is on) still runs the tray's own action, so it never does nothing. Offline/online mode has no route: it has to work when the model can't. The study phrases themselves are tool_policy.json study_commands (shared with the wake word).
commands._mode_phrases: The whole message, any case, surrounding spaces and a trailing . or ! ignored. The first online phrase is the one the offline notice tells him to use.
commands._reminders: Whole-message regex (lower-cased, spaces collapsed, trailing .!? dropped) that opens the reminder card. Whole-message only, so 'remind me to call the dentist' still goes to the model and becomes a task.

text._doc: Wording. {fields} are filled in by the code; a template may only use the fields shown.

activity.none_yet: No independent jobs have run yet.
activity.unreadable: I couldn't read the activity record. Check the local agent state.

chat.went_offline: Offline. Type or say "{online}" to resume.
chat.still_offline: Offline -- say or type "{online}" to resume.

text.news_prompt: Give me a short summary of today's news.
text.tk_timeout: the study clock didn't answer in time

timing._doc: reminder_hour: the first reminder check at or after this local hour nags about due tasks (DENISSE_REMINDER_HOUR overrides). reminder_window_hours: due within this many hours counts as 'soon'. The unlock watcher polls every unlock_poll_s; a wall-clock jump of more than unlock_poll_s + sleep_jump_s means the machine slept; it shows the card at most once per unlock_min_gap_s, unlock_settle_s after the desktop is back. heard_display_ms: DENISSE_HEARD_DISPLAY_MS overrides.

chat._doc: The chat flyout. width/height shrink to fit the work area less screen_margin. bubble_side_room / system_side_room: canvas width not used by wrapped text. glow_strip: the 'light worm' running up and down the sides, glow_step px per frame. bubble_outline: outline width. time_inset: the bubble's time stamp, up from its bottom edge. padding: the space around each part of the flyout (header, the status text, the close button, the input row and the entry in it, the typing line, the message canvas).

glow._doc: The neon look: how the glows behind bubbles, the header line, the send disc and the side 'light worm' are drawn. *_alpha are 0-255. width_mult: a glow's width as a multiple of the line it sits behind. *_blur: blur radius as a multiple of the outline width (outline_blur), the line's glow room (line_blur) or the shape's size (disc_blur, worm_blur). line_pad: px of glow room above and below the header line. disc_pad_min / disc_pad_frac: room round the send disc for its halo (the larger of a px floor and a fraction of its size). worm_start / worm_end: where the worm's bright core starts and ends, as fractions of its height.

fonts._doc: stack: first installed family wins (TkDefaultFont if none). Sizes in points. icon_files: TrueType files tried for the tray icon's letter.

icon._doc: The tray icon: a letter in a ring, drawn so no icon file ships. letter_frac: letter height as a fraction of size.

colours._doc: #rrggbb. Tron-style: black void, thin glowing purple outlines. *_alpha are 0-255 tints over black.
